question: Which electrolyte abnormality is most dangerous in kidney failure?

explanation_ne: विफल मिर्गौलाले पोटासियम निकाल्न सक्दैन, र गम्भीर हाइपरक्यालेमियाले घातक मुटुको ताल बिगार्न सक्छ।

question: The Westergren method is used to measure which of the following?

explanation_ne: वेस्टरग्रेन विधिले इरिथ्रोसाइट सेडिमेन्टेसन दर (ESR) नाप्छ।

question: A person with blood group AB is known as what type of recipient?

question: What is the normal haemoglobin level for an adult woman?

explanation_ne: आइरनको कमीले माइक्रोसाइटिक रातो कोष बनाउँछ, त्यसैले MCV कम हुन्छ; TIBC र RDW बढेका हुन्छन्।

explanation_ne: कार्डियाक ट्रोपोनिन मायोकार्डियल क्षतिको सबैभन्दा विशिष्ट सूचक हो।

question: Which lipid is known as 'good cholesterol'?

question: Which specimen is best for measuring blood glucose in a laboratory?

explanation_ne: फ्लोराइडले ग्लाइकोलाइसिस रोक्छ, त्यसैले फ्लोराइड-अक्सालेट ट्युबले ग्लुकोज जोगाउँछ।

question: Which vitamin deficiency is detected by a raised serum methylmalonic acid level?

explanation_ne: भिटामिन B12 को कमीले मेथिलमालोनिक एसिड बढाउँछ किनभने यसको चयापचयमा B12 चाहिन्छ।

question: Which test measures kidney function using both urea and creatinine?
explanation: A renal function test includes serum urea and creatinine to assess kidney function.

explanation_ne: मिर्गौला कार्य परीक्षणमा मिर्गौलाको कार्य जाँच्न सीरम युरिया र क्रिएटिनिन समावेश हुन्छन्।

question: Which fungus is most commonly grown on Sabouraud dextrose agar?
explanation: Sabouraud dextrose agar is the standard medium for growing fungi such as Candida albicans.

explanation_ne: साबुरो डेक्सट्रोज एगर क्यान्डिडा अल्बिकान्स जस्ता ढुसी बढाउने मानक माध्यम हो।

question: What is the most common specimen for diagnosing pulmonary tuberculosis?
explanation: Sputum is the standard specimen for detecting M. tuberculosis in pulmonary TB.

explanation_ne: फोक्सोको TB मा M. tuberculosis पत्ता लगाउन खकार मानक नमुना हो।

question: Which anticoagulant is used for measuring ESR by the Westergren method?
explanation: The Westergren ESR uses blood anticoagulated with 3.8% sodium citrate.

question_ne: वेस्टरग्रेन विधिबाट ESR नाप्न कुन एन्टिकोआगुलेन्ट प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: वेस्टरग्रेन ESR मा ३.८% सोडियम साइट्रेटयुक्त रगत प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

question: Which cells are the first to arrive at a site of acute bacterial infection?
explanation: Neutrophils are the first white cells to reach an acute bacterial infection.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तीव्र ब्याक्टेरियल संक्रमणको ठाउँमा सबैभन्दा पहिले पुग्ने कोषिका कुन हुन्?
explanation_ne: न्युट्रोफिल तीव्र ब्याक्टेरियल संक्रमणमा सबैभन्दा पहिले पुग्ने सेता कोषिका हुन्।

question: Which hormone is measured to assess thyroid function together with TSH?
explanation: Free T4 is measured alongside TSH to assess thyroid function.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: TSH सँगै थाइराइड कार्य जाँच्न कुन हर्मोन नापिन्छ?
explanation_ne: थाइराइड कार्य जाँच्न TSH सँगै फ्री T4 नापिन्छ।

question: What is the normal range of serum sodium?
explanation: Normal serum sodium is about 135–145 mmol/L.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सीरम सोडियमको सामान्य दायरा कति हुन्छ?

question: Which electrolyte is most affected in diabetic ketoacidosis?
explanation: Potassium shifts dangerously in diabetic ketoacidosis and must be monitored closely.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: डायबेटिक केटोएसिडोसिसमा कुन इलेक्ट्रोलाइट सबैभन्दा बढी प्रभावित हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: डायबेटिक केटोएसिडोसिसमा पोटासियम खतरनाक रूपमा सर्छ र यसको नजिकबाट निगरानी गर्नुपर्छ।

question: What colour is normal urine?
explanation: Normal urine is pale yellow to amber because of the pigment urochrome.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सामान्य पिसाबको रङ कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: सामान्य पिसाब युरोक्रोम पिग्मेन्टका कारण फिक्का पहेँलो देखि अम्बर रङको हुन्छ।

question: Ketone bodies in urine are most commonly found in which condition?
explanation: Ketones appear in urine when fat is broken down for energy, as in uncontrolled diabetes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पिसाबमा केटोन बडी सबैभन्दा बढी कुन अवस्थामा पाइन्छ?
explanation_ne: अनियन्त्रित मधुमेहमा ऊर्जाका लागि बोसो टुट्दा पिसाबमा केटोन देखा पर्छ।

question: Which parasite is transmitted by eating undercooked pork containing cysticerci?
explanation: Taenia solium (pork tapeworm) is acquired by eating undercooked pork with cysticerci.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सिस्टीसर्सी भएको नपाकेको सुँगुरको मासु खाँदा कुन परजीवी सर्छ?
explanation_ne: टिनिया सोलियम (सुँगुरको फित्ते जुका) सिस्टीसर्सी भएको नपाकेको सुँगुरको मासु खाँदा सर्छ।

question: Which stage of Plasmodium is injected into humans by the mosquito?
explanation: The mosquito injects sporozoites, which travel to the liver and start the infection.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: लामखुट्टेले मानिसमा प्लाज्मोडियमको कुन अवस्था सुईमार्फत पुर्‍याउँछ?
explanation_ne: लामखुट्टेले स्पोरोजोइट सुईमार्फत पुर्‍याउँछ, जुन कलेजोमा पुगेर संक्रमण सुरु गर्छ।

question: Who is a universal blood donor?
explanation: Group O red cells have no A or B antigens, so group O is the universal donor.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सार्वभौमिक रक्तदाता को हो?
explanation_ne: O समूहका रातो कोषिकामा A वा B एन्टिजेन हुँदैन, त्यसैले O समूह सार्वभौमिक दाता हो।

question: Fresh frozen plasma is stored at what temperature?
explanation: Fresh frozen plasma is stored frozen at −18°C or colder, usually −30°C or below.

question_ne: फ्रेस फ्रोजन प्लाज्मा कुन तापक्रममा भण्डारण गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: फ्रेस फ्रोजन प्लाज्मा −१८°C वा त्योभन्दा चिसो, सामान्यतया −३०°C वा तल, भण्डारण गरिन्छ।

question: What is the temperature and time used in a standard autoclave cycle?
explanation: A standard autoclave cycle is 121°C at 15 psi for 15–20 minutes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मानक अटोक्लेभ चक्रमा कुन तापक्रम र समय प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: मानक अटोक्लेभ चक्र १२१°C मा १५ psi दबाबमा १५–२० मिनेटको हुन्छ।

question: Which instrument is used to see bacteria in a laboratory?
explanation: Bacteria are too small to see with the naked eye and are viewed with a microscope.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रयोगशालामा ब्याक्टेरिया हेर्न कुन उपकरण प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: ब्याक्टेरिया नाङ्गो आँखाले देख्न नसकिने भएकाले सूक्ष्मदर्शीले हेरिन्छ।

question: What does a high reticulocyte count indicate?
explanation: Reticulocytes are young red cells, so a high count shows the marrow is actively producing red cells.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेटिक्युलोसाइट गणना बढ्नुले के देखाउँछ?
explanation_ne: रेटिक्युलोसाइट युवा रातो कोष हुन्, त्यसैले उच्च गणनाले मज्जाले सक्रिय रूपमा रातो कोष बनाइरहेको देखाउँछ।

question: Which test is the confirmatory test for HIV after a positive ELISA?
explanation: Western blot (or a second, different antibody assay) is used to confirm a positive HIV ELISA.

question_ne: ELISA पोजिटिभ भएपछि HIV पुष्टि गर्न कुन परीक्षण गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: वेस्टर्न ब्लट (वा दोस्रो फरक एन्टिबडी परीक्षण) ले पोजिटिभ HIV ELISA पुष्टि गर्छ।

question: What does X-ray stand for in radiography?
options: X-radiation — electromagnetic radiation of short wavelength

question_ne: रेडियोग्राफीमा एक्स-रे भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
options_ne: एक्स-विकिरण — छोटो तरंगदैर्ध्य भएको विद्युत-चुम्बकीय विकिरण
explanation_ne: एक्स-रे धेरै छोटो तरंगदैर्ध्य भएको विद्युत-चुम्बकीय विकिरण हो, जुन १८९५ मा रोन्टजेनले पत्ता लगाएका थिए।

question: In an X-ray tube, which part produces the X-rays?

explanation_ne: फिलामेन्टबाट निस्केका इलेक्ट्रोन एनोड टार्गेटमा ठोक्किँदा ब्रेम्सस्ट्रालुङ र विशेष विकिरणबाट एक्स-रे बन्छ।

question: What does kVp control in an X-ray exposure?
explanation: Kilovoltage peak (kVp) controls the energy and penetrating power of the X-ray beam.

question_ne: एक्स-रे एक्सपोजरमा kVp ले के नियन्त्रण गर्छ?
explanation_ne: किलोवोल्टेज पिक (kVp) ले एक्स-रे किरणको ऊर्जा र भेदन शक्ति नियन्त्रण गर्छ।

explanation: Milliampere-seconds (mAs) control the number of X-ray photons, i.e. the quantity of the beam.

explanation_ne: मिलिअम्पियर-सेकेन्ड (mAs) ले एक्स-रे फोटोनको संख्या, अर्थात् किरणको मात्रा नियन्त्रण गर्छ।

question: What is the purpose of a dosimeter badge worn by radiographers?
options: To measure the cumulative radiation dose received by staff
explanation: A dosimeter badge records the cumulative radiation dose a worker receives over time.

explanation_ne: डोसिमिटर ब्याजले कामदारले समयसँगै प्राप्त गरेको कुल विकिरण डोज रेकर्ड गर्छ।

question: Which device is worn by radiographers to monitor personal radiation dose?

question_ne: रेडियोग्राफरले व्यक्तिगत विकिरण डोज निगरानी गर्न कुन उपकरण लगाउँछन्?
explanation_ne: थर्मोल्युमिनेसेन्ट डोसिमिटर (TLD) ब्याजले प्राप्त कुल विकिरण डोज रेकर्ड गर्छ।

question: Which material is most commonly used for shielding against X-rays?

source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एक्स-रे विरुद्ध ढालका रूपमा सबैभन्दा बढी कुन सामग्री प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: सिसा उच्च परमाणु संख्या र घनत्व भएकाले एक्स-रे ढालको मानक सामग्री हो।

question: What is the annual effective dose limit for radiation workers?

question_ne: विकिरण कामदारका लागि वार्षिक प्रभावकारी डोज सीमा कति हो?
explanation_ne: ICRP ले सिफारिस गरेको व्यावसायिक डोज सीमा ५ वर्षमा औसत २० mSv प्रतिवर्ष हो।

question: Which view is standard for a chest X-ray?
explanation: The standard erect chest X-ray is taken posteroanterior (PA) to minimise heart magnification.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: छातीको एक्स-रेको मानक भ्यु कुन हो?
explanation_ne: मानक उभिएको छातीको एक्स-रे पोस्टेरोएन्टेरियर (PA) लिइन्छ ताकि मुटुको ठूलो देखिने समस्या कम होस्।

question: Which contrast medium is used for an intravenous urogram (IVU)?
explanation: Iodinated water-soluble contrast is used for IVU; barium is only for the gut.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इन्ट्राभेनस युरोग्राम (IVU) का लागि कुन कन्ट्रास्ट माध्यम प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: IVU का लागि आयोडिनयुक्त पानीमा घुल्ने कन्ट्रास्ट प्रयोग गरिन्छ; बेरियम आन्द्राका लागि मात्र हो।

question: Which contrast agent is used for a barium meal study?
explanation: Barium sulphate suspension coats the gut wall and is used for barium meal and enema studies.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बेरियम मील अध्ययनका लागि कुन कन्ट्रास्ट एजेन्ट प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: बेरियम सल्फेट झोलले आन्द्राको भित्ता ढाक्छ र बेरियम मील तथा एनिमा अध्ययनमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Which imaging technique is safe in pregnancy because it uses no ionising radiation?
explanation: Ultrasound uses sound waves and no ionising radiation, so it is the imaging of choice in pregnancy.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयोनाइजिङ विकिरण प्रयोग नगर्ने भएकाले गर्भावस्थामा सुरक्षित इमेजिङ प्रविधि कुन हो?
explanation_ne: अल्ट्रासाउन्डले ध्वनि तरंग प्रयोग गर्छ र आयोनाइजिङ विकिरण हुँदैन, त्यसैले गर्भावस्थामा यो रोजाइको इमेजिङ हो।

question: Which modality gives the best soft-tissue detail of the brain?
explanation: MRI provides the best soft-tissue contrast and detail for the brain.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मस्तिष्कको नरम तन्तुको सबैभन्दा राम्रो विवरण कुन विधिले दिन्छ?
explanation_ne: MRI ले मस्तिष्कको नरम तन्तुको सबैभन्दा राम्रो कन्ट्रास्ट र विवरण दिन्छ।

question: What does CT stand for?

source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: CT को पूरा रूप के हो?
explanation_ne: CT को अर्थ कम्प्युटराइज्ड (कम्प्युटेड) टोमोग्राफी हो, जसले एक्स-रे डाटाबाट क्रस-सेक्सनल तस्बिर बनाउँछ।

question: Which contrast agent is used in MRI?
explanation: Gadolinium-based contrast agents are used in MRI to enhance tissue contrast.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: MRI मा कुन कन्ट्रास्ट एजेन्ट प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: MRI मा तन्तुको कन्ट्रास्ट बढाउन ग्याडोलिनियम-आधारित कन्ट्रास्ट एजेन्ट प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

question: Increasing the distance between the X-ray tube and the patient has what effect on dose?

explanation: Radiation intensity falls with the square of the distance (inverse square law), so dose decreases.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एक्स-रे ट्युब र बिरामीबीचको दूरी बढाउँदा डोजमा के असर पर्छ?
explanation_ne: विकिरणको तीव्रता दूरीको वर्गसँगै घट्छ (इन्भर्स स्क्वायर नियम), त्यसैले डोज घट्छ।

question: Which of these is a deterministic effect of radiation?
explanation: Deterministic effects, such as skin erythema, appear only above a threshold dose and increase in severity with dose.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: यीमध्ये विकिरणको डिटरमिनिस्टिक असर कुन हो?
explanation_ne: छालाको रातोपन जस्ता डिटरमिनिस्टिक असर निश्चित डोजभन्दा माथि मात्र देखा पर्छ र डोजसँगै गम्भीरता बढ्छ।

question: A 'coin lesion' seen on a chest X-ray most often suggests which condition?

explanation_ne: क्वाइन लिजन गोलो, स्पष्ट एक्लो फोक्सोको गाँठो हो, जुन ट्युमर हुन सक्छ।

question: Which imaging test is the first choice for suspected gallstones?

question: What is the third stage of labour?
options: Expulsion of the placenta and membranes

question: What is the partograph used for?

question: What is postpartum haemorrhage (PPH)?

question: What is the Apgar score used for?

question: When should breastfeeding be started after birth?

question_ne: जन्मपछि स्तनपान कहिले सुरु गर्नुपर्छ?

question: What is abruptio placentae?

question_ne: चाँडै स्तनपान सुरु गर्नुको मुख्य फाइदा के हो?

question: Which reflex is tested by stroking the baby's cheek?

question_ne: बच्चाको गाला छुँदा कुन रिफ्लेक्स परीक्षण गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: गाला छुँदा रुटिङ रिफ्लेक्स सुरु हुन्छ, जसले बच्चाको टाउको छोएकोतर्फ फर्काएर स्तन खोज्छ।

question: What is the Moro reflex?

question_ne: मोरो रिफ्लेक्स भनेको के हो?
options_ne: हात फैलाएर फेरि अँगालो हालेजस्तो झस्किने प्रतिक्रिया
explanation_ne: मोरो रिफ्लेक्स नवजातको झस्किने प्रतिक्रिया हो: हात फैलिन्छन् र फेरि अँगालो हालेजस्तो आउँछन्।

question: What is the main purpose of antenatal care?
options: To monitor mother and baby and prevent complications
explanation: Antenatal care monitors the health of mother and baby, detects risks early and prevents complications.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रसवपूर्व हेरचाहको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?

question: What is the term for labour starting before 37 weeks?
explanation: Preterm labour is labour that begins before 37 completed weeks of pregnancy.

question_ne: ३७ हप्ताअघि प्रसव सुरु हुनुलाई के भनिन्छ?

question: What is the term for pregnancy lasting beyond 42 weeks?
explanation: A pregnancy beyond 42 weeks is post-term (prolonged) pregnancy.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ४२ हप्ताभन्दा बढी चल्ने गर्भावस्थालाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: ४२ हप्ताभन्दा बढीको गर्भावस्था पोस्ट-टर्म (लामो) गर्भावस्था हो।

question: Which family planning method can be started immediately after childbirth?
explanation: Progestin-only pills, implants and IUDs can be started soon after childbirth, even while breastfeeding.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बच्चा जन्मिएपछि तुरुन्त कुन परिवार नियोजन विधि सुरु गर्न सकिन्छ?
explanation_ne: प्रोजेस्टिन-मात्र चक्की, इम्प्लान्ट र IUD बच्चा जन्मिएपछि चाँडै, स्तनपानमा पनि, सुरु गर्न सकिन्छ।

question: What is the leading cause of death in the first week after birth in Nepal?
explanation: Birth asphyxia is a leading cause of early neonatal death in Nepal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेपालमा जन्मपछिको पहिलो हप्तामा मृत्युको प्रमुख कारण के हो?
explanation_ne: जन्म श्वासरोध नेपालमा प्रारम्भिक नवजात मृत्युको प्रमुख कारण हो।

question: What is the recommended time to cut the umbilical cord after birth?
explanation: Delayed cord clamping (1–3 minutes after birth) improves the baby's iron stores.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: जन्मपछि नाभीको डोरी काट्ने सिफारिस गरिएको समय कति हो?
explanation_ne: ढिलो नाभी काट्ने (जन्मको १–३ मिनेटपछि) ले बच्चाको आइरन भण्डार सुधार्छ।

question: What is the normal length of a newborn at birth?
explanation: The normal length of a newborn is about 45–55 cm (average around 50 cm).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नवजातको जन्ममा सामान्य लम्बाइ कति हुन्छ?

question: Which condition is anaemia in pregnancy defined as haemoglobin below what level?
explanation: Anaemia in pregnancy is defined as haemoglobin below 11 g/dL (WHO).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: गर्भावस्थामा रक्तअल्पता हेमोग्लोबिन कुन स्तरभन्दा कम हुँदा परिभाषित गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: गर्भावस्थामा रक्तअल्पता हेमोग्लोबिन ११ ग्राम/डेसिलिटरभन्दा कम हुँदा परिभाषित गरिन्छ (WHO)।

question: What is the most common cause of obstructed labour?

source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अवरोधित प्रसवको सबैभन्दा सामान्य कारण के हो?
explanation_ne: सेफालोपेल्भिक असमानता, जहाँ बच्चाको टाउको पेल्भिसका लागि धेरै ठूलो हुन्छ, अवरोधित प्रसवको सबैभन्दा सामान्य कारण हो।

question: Which of these is a danger sign in a newborn?

question_ne: यीमध्ये नवजातमा खतराको संकेत कुन हो?
explanation_ne: दूध नखाने र असामान्य रूपमा निदाउने वा सुस्त नवजातलाई तुरुन्त जाँच चाहिन्छ।

question: What is the main purpose of postnatal care visits?
options: To plan the next pregnancy only
To check the mother's recovery and the baby's health
To give the baby a name
explanation: Postnatal visits check the mother's recovery, detect complications early and monitor the baby's health.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रसवोत्तर हेरचाह भेटको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
options_ne: आमाको निको र बच्चाको स्वास्थ्य जाँच्न
explanation_ne: प्रसवोत्तर भेटले आमाको निको जाँच्छ, जटिलता चाँडै पत्ता लगाउँछ र बच्चाको स्वास्थ्य निगरानी गर्छ।

question: What is the recommended sleeping position for a newborn to reduce sudden infant death?
explanation: Babies should sleep on their backs to reduce the risk of sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अचानक शिशु मृत्यु घटाउन नवजातलाई कुन आसनमा सुताउन सिफारिस गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: अचानक शिशु मृत्यु सिन्ड्रोम (SIDS) को जोखिम घटाउन बच्चालाई ढाडमा सुताउनुपर्छ।

question: What is the term for the bag of waters breaking before labour?

question_ne: प्रसवअघि पानीको थैली फुट्नुलाई के भनिन्छ?

question: What is the far point of a myopic eye?
options: At a finite distance in front of the eye
explanation: In myopia the far point is at a finite distance in front of the eye; objects beyond it are blurred.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal

question: Which part of the eye is responsible for producing tears?

question: What is keratitis?

question_ne: केराटाइटिस भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: केराटाइटिस कर्नियाको सुजन हो, प्रायः संक्रमण वा चोटबाट हुन्छ।

question: What is the main risk factor for age-related macular degeneration?
explanation: Age-related macular degeneration is linked to increasing age, smoking and family history.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: उमेरसम्बन्धी म्याकुलर डिजेनेरेसनको मुख्य जोखिम कारक के हो?
explanation_ne: उमेरसम्बन्धी म्याकुलर डिजेनेरेसन बढ्दो उमेर, धूमपान र पारिवारिक इतिहाससँग जोडिएको छ।

question: What does the Amsler grid test detect?
explanation: The Amsler grid detects distortion or blind spots in central vision, suggesting macular disease.

question_ne: एम्सलर ग्रिड परीक्षणले के पत्ता लगाउँछ?
explanation_ne: एम्सलर ग्रिडले केन्द्रीय दृष्टिमा विकृति वा अन्धो ठाउँ पत्ता लगाउँछ, जसले म्याकुलर रोग सुझाउँछ।

question: What is anisometropia?
options: Same refractive error in both eyes
Different refractive error in the two eyes
explanation: Anisometropia is a significant difference in refractive error between the two eyes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एनाइसोमेट्रोपिया भनेको के हो?

question: Which structure holds the lens in place?

source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कुन संरचनाले लेन्सलाई ठाउँमा राख्छ?

question: What is the most common cause of red eye in children?
explanation: Conjunctivitis is the most common cause of red eye in children.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बच्चामा रातो आँखाको सबैभन्दा सामान्य कारण के हो?

question: Which condition is a drooping of the upper eyelid?
explanation: Ptosis is the drooping of the upper eyelid, which can block vision.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: माथिल्लो आँखीभौँ झोलिनु कुन अवस्था हो?

question: At what distance is the Snellen chart normally placed?
explanation: The Snellen chart is normally placed at 6 metres (20 feet) for distance vision testing.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: स्नेलन चार्ट सामान्यतया कति दूरीमा राखिन्छ?
explanation_ne: स्नेलन चार्ट टाढाको दृष्टि परीक्षणका लागि सामान्यतया ६ मिटर (२० फिट) मा राखिन्छ।

question: Which glasses have two different powers for distance and near vision?
explanation: Bifocal glasses have an upper part for distance and a lower part for near vision.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: टाढा र नजिकको दृष्टिका लागि दुई फरक शक्ति भएको चस्मा कुन हो?
explanation_ne: बाइफोकल चस्मामा टाढाका लागि माथिल्लो भाग र नजिकका लागि तल्लो भाग हुन्छ।

question: What is the black circular opening in the centre of the iris called?
explanation: The pupil is the black opening in the centre of the iris through which light enters the eye.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आइरिसको केन्द्रमा रहेको कालो गोलो खुलापनलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: पुतली आइरिसको केन्द्रमा रहेको कालो खुलापन हो, जसबाट प्रकाश आँखामा प्रवेश गर्छ।

question: What is the main symptom of cataract?
explanation: Cataract typically causes gradual, painless blurring of vision.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मोतियाबिन्दुको मुख्य लक्षण के हो?
explanation_ne: मोतियाबिन्दुले सामान्यतया बिस्तारै, दुखाइबिना दृष्टि धमिलो बनाउँछ।

question: Which type of glaucoma is an emergency with sudden eye pain and blurred vision?
explanation: Acute angle-closure glaucoma causes sudden eye pain, blurred vision and halos, and is an emergency.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अचानक आँखा दुखाइ र धमिलो दृष्टिसहितको आपत्कालीन ग्लुकोमा कुन हो?
explanation_ne: तीव्र एङ्गल-क्लोजर ग्लुकोमाले अचानक आँखा दुखाइ, धमिलो दृष्टि र हेलो गराउँछ र यो आपत्कालीन अवस्था हो।

question: What does a plus (+) lens power indicate?
explanation: Plus lenses converge light and are used to correct hypermetropia and presbyopia.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्लस (+) लेन्स शक्तिले के देखाउँछ?
explanation_ne: प्लस लेन्सले प्रकाश एकत्रित गर्छ र हाइपरमेट्रोपिया तथा प्रेस्बायोपिया सच्याउन प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Which part of the retina is responsible for sharp central vision?
explanation: The macula, especially the fovea, provides sharp central vision.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेटिनाको कुन भागले तीखो केन्द्रीय दृष्टि दिन्छ?

question: What is dry eye syndrome?
options: Insufficient tears or poor tear quality
explanation: Dry eye syndrome is caused by insufficient tear production or poor tear quality.

question_ne: सुख्खा आँखा सिन्ड्रोम भनेको के हो?
options_ne: अपर्याप्त आँसु वा खराब आँसु गुणस्तर
explanation_ne: सुख्खा आँखा सिन्ड्रोम अपर्याप्त आँसु उत्पादन वा खराब आँसु गुणस्तरले हुन्छ।

question: What is the legal definition of blindness in many countries?
options: Complete loss of light perception only
Vision worse than 6/60 in the better eye
explanation: Legal blindness is often defined as visual acuity worse than 6/60 (or 20/200) in the better eye with correction.

question_ne: धेरै देशमा अन्धोपनको कानुनी परिभाषा के हो?
options_ne: प्रकाश बोध पूर्ण रूपमा गुम्नु मात्र
explanation_ne: कानुनी अन्धोपन प्रायः सच्याइसहित राम्रो आँखामा ६/६० (वा २०/२००) भन्दा खराब दृश्य तीक्ष्णता भनेर परिभाषित गरिन्छ।

question: Which nerve carries visual signals from the eye to the brain?
explanation: The optic nerve (cranial nerve II) carries visual information from the retina to the brain.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आँखाबाट मस्तिष्कमा दृश्य संकेत बोक्ने स्नायु कुन हो?

question: What is the main cause of trachoma?

source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ट्राकोमाको मुख्य कारण के हो?
explanation_ne: ट्राकोमा क्ल्यामिडिया ट्राकोमाटिसले गराउने दीर्घकालीन आँखा संक्रमण हो, जुन अन्धोपनको प्रमुख संक्रामक कारण हो।
